Pakistan Minister Alleges Officials Fleeing 'Sinking Ship'

Pakistan's Defence Minister Khawaja Asif has stated that officials are fleeing the country, likening the situation to rats abandoning a sinking ship. He specifically mentioned Portugal as a destination for those leaving. Asif's remarks have sparked debate regarding the trust officials have in their own nation.
